quarterly_data.quarter: SUSS MicroTec press release: SUSS enters Wafer-Cleaning Market with launch of GreenTec (10-01-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: SUSS entered the wafer-level cleaning market with the GreenTec Solutions product line and its first system, the GT200 (200 mm; R&D, process qualification and production for MEMS, RF, power device and CMOS applications), combining its TurbulenStrip and CrustBuster photomask technologies without hazardous acids or organic solvents. SUSS puts the addressable wafer-cleaning market at approximately EUR 5.4 billion, driven by advanced packaging, heterogeneous integration and AI / high-performance computing demand. A dedicated 300 mm high-volume manufacturing platform follows in 2027 (launch pulled in on strong customer interest, SVP Photomask Solutions Yuta Nagai) and a 200 mm HVM platform in 2028.
quarterly_data.figure: addressable market approximately EUR 5.4 billion; 300 mm HVM platform in 2027; 200 mm HVM platform in 2028
